note: DSK Bank's tariff for individuals (in force from 1 April 2026): its Visa Galaxy revolving credit card's main card costs 25 euros a year, not charged where the card makes 24 transactions in its first year, a condition the game doesn't check, so the fee is charged in full. The card's standard interest rate on DSK Bank's credit card page is 18.90% a year.
